name: project-task-tracker
description: A collaborative project management application built with React, Express, MongoDB, Docker, and Kubernetes

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install -w client && npm install -w api
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w client & npm run dev -w api
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w api
scripts.test: npm run test:run -w client && npm run test:run -w api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w api

author: Team
